title: Grounds Maintenance Munich
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-OO.409TH CSB.0409 AQ HQ     CONTRACT
detail_text: SOURCES SOUGHT ONLY This is a sources sought only for non-personal service(s) for Grounds Maintenance services in Munich, Germany 81679. Services provided shall be lawn care, shrub and tree maintenance, landscapping, debris removal, weed control, snow and ice removal, general maintenance and inspections. Seeking sources that are capable of providing services in this area, must be SAM.gov registered. This sources sought closes on 01 April 2026, 10AM CEST. You may respond to this sources sought by sending an email to SFC Shalynn Evans at shalynn.a.evans.mil@army.mil.
